_comment: Cast-time control. windup is the Magic NPCs aim delay before casting starts; cast_time and cast_time_multiplier change how long the LONG or CONTINUOUS cast itself takes. Both are ignored on INSTANT spells such as magic_missile.

spells._comment: Absolute form: exactly 6 ticks of native cast, instead of the 15 the spell normally takes. cast_time always wins over cast_time_multiplier when both are set.
Multiplier form: 2.0 makes the channel twice as long, for a heavily telegraphed set piece.
